visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back, wearing an off-the-shoulder black top and silver jewelry, stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. She smiles and gestures enthusiastically toward the camera while talking. (2) She brings her hands together in front of her chest and then points to her face, highlighting her eyes and facial contours. Yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen. (3) She holds up a small black rectangular makeup palette (KATE eyebrow powder). She opens it to reveal three shades of powder and a brush. She uses the brush to apply the powder to her eyebrows and then to the sides of her nose bridge for contouring. (4) She holds up a KATE eyeshadow palette with brown tones. She uses an applicator to apply medium brown shades to her eyelids and then uses her finger to apply a lighter, shimmery shade to the center of her eyelid. (5) She holds up a black liquid eyeliner pen. She draws a precise thin wing on the outer corner of her upper eyelid. (6) She holds up a dark brown lipstick tube. She applies the reddish-brown lipstick to her lips, focusing on the camera in a close-up shot. (7) She poses for the camera, showing off the completed makeup look from various angles. She smiles and uses hand gestures to emphasize her facial features. (8) All the KATE makeup products used in the video—the eyebrow palette, eyeshadow, eyeliner, and lipstick—are displayed together on a light-colored surface alongside their caps.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long dark hair tied back in a ponytail. She wears an off-the-shoulder black top, a silver necklace with a musical note pendant, and small pearl earrings. Her makeup is refined with a focus on defined eyes and reddish-brown lips.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, minimalist studio background with soft white/grey walls and blurred professional lighting equipment or studio items in the far background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, energetic female voice introduces the makeup tutorial over an upbeat electronic background track with a steady 4/4 beat. The audio environment is clean and professional. (2) As she discusses the eyebrow palette, the sound of the plastic compact clicking open is heard, followed by soft brushing sounds as she narrates the application process. (3) Transitioning to eyeshadow, the narration remains fast-paced and enthusiastic. The music maintains its energetic tempo. Subtle sliding sounds of the applicator can be heard. (4) The narrator highlights the eyeliner, accompanied by a sharp click as the pen cap is removed. Her pitch rises slightly when emphasizing the pen's precision. (5) During the lipstick application, the sound of the lipstick tube twisting is audible. The voice becomes warmer as she describes the texture and popularity of the product. (6) The video concludes with a final enthusiastic summary, and the BGM swells slightly before fading out cleanly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-step product demonstration -> Conclusion -> Call-to-action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote KATE TOKYO makeup products by demonstrating how to achieve a deep-contoured, three-dimensional makeup look using affordable drugstore items that rival high-end department store quality.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand KATE and showing specific products with logos and naming their shades and benefits.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video follows a standard social-media beauty tutorial format with high information density, rapid editing, and clear brand placement.
